This test suite addresses the previously identified inadequacies by grounding all values to the requirement specifications, including the alarm signal, buzzer command, alarm code, priority list, active alarms list, and display settings. It also includes positive test cases for each requirement, ensuring clause coverage, and avoids negative or error path tests. Oracle assertions are now concrete and checkable, and boundary and timing tests for flashing frequency and duty cycle are included. The suite also verifies actual color codes and legibility at the specified distance.
